SET RIGHTFLATWORK

Concrete Done Right. From the Ground Up.

Set Right Flatwork LLC is a Louisville, Kentucky-based concrete flatwork contractor specializing in residential and commercial concrete solutions. Led by owner Phoebus Cotsapas, the company focuses on practical workmanship, attention to detail, straightforward communication, and quality-focused concrete installation.
